inputs.name: a run request from the Requesting Authority's Cell, naming the way in (mode A, B or C) and the design or sources to start from
inputs.format: Work Item (ID + version), received through the HU input port at the tool gateway

inputs.name: mode A: the decided releases of the target operating model and of Process and Position Design
inputs.format: release reference (ID + version + hash of its manifest), received through the Input socket from Process and Position Design, through the tool gateway

inputs.name: mode B: a design made elsewhere, filed as a source in Source Lifecycle
inputs.format: source reference (ID + version + hash), received through the Input socket

inputs.name: the organisation's other sources, and in mode C everything it starts from, by reference only, from the output socket of Source Lifecycle
inputs.format: source reference (ID + version + hash; held or not held), received through the Input socket

inputs.name: records of work from the organisation's own tools, read only, through a projection owned by top management that removes who did the work; only after the organisation records its impact assessment and informs workers where law requires
inputs.format: record references through a signed connection at the tool gateway

inputs.name: decisions of the deciding positions on its drafts and proposals
inputs.format: decision references; signed records at the gateway for listed types

outputs.name: returns to the stage that made a design release, under the Library's design return contract
outputs.format: Work Item (ID + version) validating against library/contracts/design-return.schema.json, sent through the tool gateway

outputs.name: needs requests to the Chief of Staff of Source Lifecycle
outputs.format: Work Item sub-items (ID + version), sent through the tool gateway

outputs.name: the gap report, in two tiers: what blocks launch, and what is incomplete; each gap with its consequence, evidence and a proposed fix
outputs.format: versioned record, filed into Source Lifecycle

outputs.name: the launch package: procedures under each process; drafts of policies, of the pay structure by job family and level, of the authority instruments and of the obligations register, each marked as a draft for professional review in its jurisdiction; the control matrix; the transition plan; the go-live criteria; readiness, rehearsals and the go or no-go package for the deciding position
outputs.format: content-addressed records, filed into Source Lifecycle; each element decided by its deciding position

outputs.name: the operating records: the operating rhythm and its logs, measures and forum packs, versions with their acknowledgements, runnable checklists, quarterly priorities and the value register
outputs.format: versioned records, each traced to its design element and deciding position

outputs.name: proposals for change at process level, trial records and the organisation health check, each to the position that can decide it
outputs.format: Work Item (ID + version), sent through the tool gateway

outputs.name: a full export with its trace

tool_roles: source of record (the output socket of Source Lifecycle)
the output port of Process and Position Design (releases in, returns out)
tool gateway (signatures, metering, the stop door, the permission ladder)
the organisation's own tools, read only by default, each a signed connection
engines through the shared gateway; a verifier that did not write a draft checks it
